news.headline: Global Market: Eurozone banking crisis fears return as government borrowing costs surge
news.summary: Rising euro zone borrowing costs have renewed fears of a sovereign debt crisis, particularly in France. European banks’ stronger capital buffers, diversified bond holdings and tighter regulation offer protection, but prolonged market volatility could increase funding costs, weaken profitability and revive investor concerns over banks’ exposure to government debt.

news.headline: Jio IPO strengthens Reliance’s financial flexibility; capex funding remains key: Moody’s
news.summary: Moody’s has termed Jio Platforms’ IPO credit positive for Reliance Industries, citing debt repayment and funding flexibility. The Rs 30,200 crore issue will support investments while helping manage leverage amid elevated capital expenditure.

news.headline: Rs 30,213 crore, 100 minutes, Rs 2.5 lakh crore: How Jio IPO broke 3 records even before listing
news.summary: Reliance Industries’ Jio Platforms has set new IPO records, with its Rs 30,213 crore issue becoming India’s largest-ever public offering and getting fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening. The IPO surpasses Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870 crore issue in 2024. At the upper end of its Rs 1,065–1,119 price band, Jio Platforms is valued at around Rs 10.3 lakh crore. The issue closes on October 23.

news.headline: PC Jewellers Q2 Results: Net profit shoots up 58% to Rs 331 crore; company says it is now debt-free
news.summary: PC Jewellers Ltd has achieved an impressive 58 percent growth in net profit for Q2 of the 2026-27 fiscal year, driven by sales that surged beyond Rs 1,054 crore. The company is now debt-free after early repayment to banks and is set to unveil a new jewellery brand aimed at attracting younger consumers.

news.headline: Sky Gold and Diamonds among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 45% in a month
news.summary: Despite the Sensex falling 143 points on Wednesday, five BSE 1000 stocks hit fresh 52-week highs. PC Jeweller led monthly gains at 45%, followed by Sky Gold and Diamonds, HFCL, South Indian Bank and Tatva Chintan Pharma Chem.

news.headline: Want exposure to India's biggest banks? Zerodha launches new ETF
news.summary: Zerodha Fund House has launched the BSE Top 10 Banks ETF, tracking India’s largest listed banks. The NFO runs from October 12 to October 26, 2026, with a minimum investment of Rs 1,000, offering focused banking exposure.

news.headline: EAAA India Alternatives fixes price band for Rs 1,200 IPO; issue opens on October 26
news.summary: EAAA India Alternatives has set a price band of Rs 1,585–1,665 for its Rs 1,200-crore IPO, opening October 26. The offer is entirely an offer for sale, with the company reporting higher income and profit in FY26.

news.headline: Jio IPO Day 1: Issue subscribed 3 times on strong QIB push; retail portion booked 68%. Check GMP
news.summary: Jio Platforms’ IPO saw strong demand on Day 1, getting booked 3 times overall. The IPO commanded a grey market premium (GMP) of around 23%, while brokerages remained optimistic, citing Jio’s telecom leadership, improving profitability and growth opportunities in broadband and artificial intelligence (AI).

news.headline: Can Jio IPO unlock hidden value in Reliance Industries shares?
Global Market: BOJ's Himino says Japan inflation near 2% target, signals further rate hikes
news.summary: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Ryozo Himino says underlying inflation is nearing the central bank’s 2% target, while accommodative financial conditions and rising cost pressures strengthen expectations of further interest rate hikes.

news.headline: Jio Platforms' IPO-linked inflows boost rupee; elevated oil prices spur caution
news.summary: The Indian rupee experienced a notable increase as Jio Platforms' IPO attracted significant foreign investments. Despite this strength, rising oil prices raised concerns among traders about the rupee's sustainability. The rupee closed at 94.46 against the dollar, with earlier gains trimmed by higher Brent crude oil prices. Analysts suggest that the upcoming RBI monetary policy might influence future exchange rates.

news.headline: MFs raise stakes in 10 stocks in Q2; shares rally up to 130% in FY27, including 3 multibaggers
news.summary: Ten BSE 500 stocks have rallied between 59% and 129% in FY27 so far as mutual funds increased their shareholding in the September 2026 quarter. Cemindia Projects, Aditya Infotech and Aegis Logistics lead the list of gainers.

news.headline: Global Market: UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September, boosting rate hike bets
news.summary: UK inflation rises to 3.5% in September from 3.1% in August, exceeding expectations as higher fuel prices linked to the Iran war add to price pressures. Sticky services and core inflation strengthen expectations of a potential Bank of England rate hike.

news.headline: From Dhirubhai to Akash Ambani, Reliance made stocks popular with Indians
news.summary: Jio Platforms’ IPO is putting the Ambani family’s relationship with India’s retail investors on a new footing, almost five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Textile Industries public in 1977. The Rs 30,213-crore issue was fully subscribed within two hours of opening, but Jio’s long-term success as a listed company will depend on whether it can turn its massive telecom and digital reach into sustained earnings growth and investor returns.

news.headline: HD Fire Protect shares list at 23% premium; expert highlights key factors to watch
news.summary: HD Fire Protect shares listed at a 23% premium over the IPO issue price of Rs 271, debuting at Rs 334.40 on the BSE and Rs 335 on the NSE. Experts say future performance will depend on customer expansion, margin stability, operating cash flows and demand for fire protection equipment.
